name: Yahenni — sacrifice, indestructible and death counters
description: Activate Yahenni by sacrificing your Grizzly Bears; Yahenni itself and your Swamps are not eligible. The opponent can cast Murder after the ability resolves: indestructible prevents destruction. On a fresh scenario, cast your Murder on the opponent’s Hill Giant to grow Yahenni with a +1/+1 counter. Haste lets Yahenni attack immediately. Restart to compare the branches; indestructible ends at the end of the turn.
